_comment: Concrete outage-safe Mac profile. Only the local provider and local storage are active; Azure, AWS and GCP remain explicitly fenced.

backup._comment: Temporary same-disk mirror/read fallback only. This is not cross-provider disaster recovery and must not replace the fenced Azure-primary plus S3 production profile.

dashboard._comment: Loopback-only API for immediate Mac operation. Dashboard view and mutations require deployment-bound authorization; object, machine and managed-service routes require their distinct credentials.

deployment._comment: Stable local dashboard RLS binding. Never remove this id: unavailable deployment authorization must fail closed.

secrets._comment: Uses the built-in loopback Skarbiec URL; the consumer and owner-only grant are explicit and must allow exactly the required fields, including stado-object-api/token, stado-machine-api/token and stado-service-api/token.

agent._comment: Dedicated local workload-agent grant. It is never the control-plane grant; jobs can project only the exact item#field allowlist.
